text:
marie: Hey folks, I'm drafting the Slate release notes for the docs site. Need quick help with: 1) one-line feature bullets, 2) short SDK snippets (TS + Python) for streaming, 3) two known issues + workarounds, and 4) anchor to perf charts. Planning to publish Friday EOD. Can people add tiny edits to the PR? :pray:

alex: Added latest perf numbers to the draft 1% latency improvement for short-seq and ~30% throughput gain for long-seq. Put charts under /docs/perf and left an anchor. Where do we want the headline blurb? Top or in "What's new"?

sam: Put the headline at the top. I'll write a 1-2 line non-jargon product blurb and paste here.

nora: I'll add the SDK snippets. @tim can you verify the TS streaming change? I left a placeholder for the retry note.

marie: Also need a compact migration note about model pinning so customers don't get surprised by fallback changes. Keep it one sentence with a link to rollout docs.

jen: From support: known issue - when fallback routes between quantized variants, embeddings can shift slightly (cosine drift). Workaround: set model_version explicitly and disable auto-fallback for eval runs. I'll add the ticket link.

alex: Let's put a "Known issues" callout near the top so it's visible. Many customers skim.

marie: Good call. Two bullets only: embeddings drift (jen) and SDK streaming retry edge-case.

tim: TS sample tested locally. Note streaming now uses async iterator (.stream()) instead of event handlers. Example I ran: ```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'slate-v1', input: 'Summarize the doc' });
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```One-line note: streaming will retry once if preempted but may return partial chunks, so apps should handle idempotent sinks.

nora: Python snippet mirror: ```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model='slate-v1', input='Summarize the doc'):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```Kept it minimal.

sam: Copy LGTM. Added sentence about Dedicated customers being able to opt into new batching behavior.

alex: Fixed a broken internal link in the migration guide (docs/migrate/quantized -> docs/migrate/quantization). Also added perf anchor perf/slate-2024-06.

jen: Added support ticket links and a quick contact line (support@redwood.ai) if customers hit the embeddings drift. Also wrote the exact workaround steps.

marie: Editorial constraint: each feature bullet must be max one sentence for the release landing. Please trim.

nora: Trimming now, will open a tiny PR with the snippet file and one-sentence bullets.

deploy-bot: docs-deploy: build queued for branch release/slate 1 queued jobs. Watch at https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4899 :robot_face:

marie: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll merge at 4pm PT and publish the notes. If you want a changelog line in CHANGELOG.md add it to the PR before merge. :shipit:
